answer: Beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each agent answers an unpredictable challenge in minutes, proving computation: a pulse nobody can fake in advance. An opal log records each miss, exposing duplicates; two misses forfeit slot and deposit. No fable: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 heartbeats, at 40 credits each, 40,000 per round, while one honest agent pays 40 and keeps its undiluted share. A gale of copies costs more than it earns.
